Conway refinement reader attribution

FloatLib's website reader, including archived versions, contains adaptations
of the Conway refinement reader:
https://github.com/gaearon/conway-refinement
Upstream reader: blueprint/src/web-reader/

LICENSE contains the Apache-2.0 text from upstream commit
264445c93b78554c408e99e4e7f663693b4e91ab.
The revision originally adapted by FloatLib was not recorded.

FloatLib modified the reader. Adaptations appear in site/reader/src/App.tsx,
MapView.tsx, data.tsx, and site/reader/styles.css; the archived SITE_SPEC.md
also records the adaptation.

Archive coverage:
  benchmarks/results/main/provenance/FloatLib-source-public.tar.gz
  tests/results/main/provenance/FloatLib-source.tar.gz
including the former archive's nested member
  tests/results/main/provenance/FloatLibrary-source.tar.gz
